title: ЗАКОН ЗА ВЪНШНАТА ТЪРГОВИЯ
evidence: The history line ends with the amendment in ДВ 4/1989, before 2003, and there is no repeal marker; both candidates (material 21361, a постановление on the free-trade agreement with Estonia, and material 108524, Наредба № 44 от 2001 г. on compound feed) repeal different acts that share only the word "търговия".
